themes.name: Pressed & Still
themes.description: A night-reading journal where deep umber paper and precisely weighted Garamond type hold a single warm accent like candlelight on a closed page.

props.text: A single flame held against umber dark. Garamond was made for patience — for the reader who underlines in pencil and returns.

themes.name: Fountain & Bone
themes.description: A split-screen poster where terracotta geometry meets mineral coolness — zellige precision rendered in high-contrast evening warmth.

props.text: Terracotta cuts across mineral cool. Zellige precision, evening heat — a poster that knows exactly where it stands.

themes.name: Chrome Frequency
themes.description: A Y2K fever dream rendered as a noir cinema poster — acid aqua scanlines cutting through midnight dark, glossy filled cards floating like holographic CD inserts, scattered with the confidence of an afternoon that knows exactly what it is.

props.text: A holographic CD spinning in a noir alley. Acid aqua scanlines. Midnight deep as a dead link. The future already happened and it looked exactly like this.
Glossy cards. Dot-grid texture. A link that turns pink the moment you touch it.

themes.name: Linen & Register
themes.description: A Scandinavian morning filtered through the precision of a typographer's lightbox — warm birch-white ground, disciplined sidebar rails, and a single copper accent that reads like a ruled red line in a field ledger.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: A typographer's morning: birch-white ground, sidebar rails ruled like ledger lines, and one copper accent that signs every page like a red ink stamp.

themes.name: Birch & Tin
themes.description: Helsinki harbour at first light — fogged linen, ice blue, and a single red warehouse bleeding through the mist, rendered in tall cold type against generous air.

props.text: Helsinki harbour at first light. Fogged linen, ice blue, a single red warehouse bleeding through the mist. Cold type against generous air.
Cold mornings, tall type, generous air.

themes.name: Last Set, Ivory
themes.description: A late-night editorial journal drawn from the amber haze of a closing jazz set — tarnished brass type, oxblood shadows, and ivory breath between columns.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: The last tune fades. Brass still warm. Ivory keys cooling under a single bulb. This is the journal of that exact room.

themes.name: Slab & Canopy
themes.description: A Niemeyer terrace translated into graphic poster language — deep shade, sculptural type, and the slow heat of a Brazilian afternoon rendered in flat material planes.

props.text: Niemeyer poured concrete into shadow. We pour ink into structure. The canopy holds the heat still — flat planes, brutal brackets, and a terrace that refuses to apologize for its geometry.
The afternoon slows. The slab casts its geometry onto the ground — a sundial that measures heat, not hours.
